extraction_notes: The datasheet SHA-256 matches the expected digest: a66d0e20d37b19b6776d33e5d234d792d89e30813774a7dde79429c97d6773dd.

Figure 3 is a real plotted forward characteristic, but it is generic to the full 1SMA4728A through 1SMA4764A series rather than specific to 1SMA4744A; points are digitized from the plotted curve only.
Figure 2 contains typical zener-impedance curves only for VZ = 25 V, 30 V, 65 V, and 91 V, so no target-specific zener-impedance curve was extracted for the 15 V nominal part.
The datasheet provides no capacitance or reverse-recovery specification for 1SMA4744A.
omission_reason: No target-specific zener-impedance curve is published for the 15 V nominal part; Figure 2 only plots VZ = 25 V, 30 V, 65 V, and 91 V. Capacitance and reverse-recovery data are also absent.
